channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Micky Arison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Micky Arison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaime Jaquez Jr on Micky Arison
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Jaime Jaquez Jr., on Micky Arison being a Hall finalist:

“I mean, it just goes to Heat Culture, man. You've got so many guys who have come along. He's been such a great owner, so big for the city of Miami. He's truly deserving of that honor.”

Jaime Jaquez Jr on Micky Arison, Feb 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Pat Riley on Micky Arison
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Pat Riley on Micky Arison:

“There's just so many accomplishments that we've achieved. ... He's just a great owner. It's a family organization.”

Pat Riley on Micky Arison, Feb 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Pat Riley on Micky Arison
item.description:
Pat Riley:

“I think it’s unbelievable that I could stay here that long, that anybody in this league can stay somewhere that long. I do thank [Heat managing general partner Micky Arison] sincerely for bypassing those moments when he probably wanted to ship me out of town. There were those days. But both of us have stayed together and I think that’s what’s important.”

Pat Riley on Micky Arison, Oct 23, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Micky Arison
item.description:

“I said to [Heat owner] Micky [Arison] the other day, is this your message?”

Pat Riley on Micky Arison, Oct 18, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Micky Arison
item.description:
Dragic, who was drafted in the second round in 2008, appeared in one All-Star Game during his NBA career, and it came in 2018 as a member of the Heat.

“I have nothing but respect for Micky [Arison], Pat, Spo. I love those guys,”

Goran Dragic on Micky Arison, Jan 11, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Micky Arison
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on new deal:

“I'm just incredibly grateful for the Arison family, Micky and Nick, Andy.”

Erik Spoelstra on Micky Arison, Jan 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Caron Butler on Micky Arison
item.description:
Caron Butler:

“The seeds they planted in your life last forever. Micky Arison and the Arison family have been amazing to me and my family, still to this day. Isaw him on Rodeo Drive All-Star Weekend and gave him a big hug. I saw Pat, as well. He still sends me text messages and we stay connected. Dwyane is godfather to my middle child, Ava. So we've got a connection that's forever. It really is. It's real family.”

Caron Butler on Micky Arison, Mar 26, 2018. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Pat Riley, Micky Arison
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Spo says

“We’re a Riley, Arison organization so we will be doing body fat tests after today’s [Family Fest].”

Erik Spoelstra on Pat Riley, Micky Arison, Mar 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Erik Spoelstra, Micky Arison
item.description:
Pat Riley on getting closure on Wade after the contract talks two years ago:

“I think you’re correct on that. For all of you who know me, warriors don’t live in the past. Life is now. And the future is waiting. Based on what happened with Dwyane and us the last couple of years, there’s no bitterness and no regrets. We’ve always talked about that. Micky [Arison] is very pro Dwyane. Coach [Erik Spoelstra] is very pro Dwyane. I am. It was a sad day when Dwyane left and it’s a beautiful day that he’s back.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Erik Spoelstra, Micky Arison, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison
item.description:
But in a podcast with The Vertical’s Adrian Wojnarowski this week, Wade admitted that Riley not calling him was the deciding factor.

“I did feel at the end of the day it's Micky Arison's team but it's Pat's show,”

Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison, Feb 14, 2017. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison, Pat Riley
item.description:
Wade on Riley:

“I dealt with Micky Arison, my contracts the last two years. He didn’t sit at the table. He didn’t call or email or text.”

Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison, Pat Riley, Jul 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Pat Riley, Micky Arison
item.description:
Months after tense, at times rancorous, contract talks culminated in a one-year, $20 million deal with the Heat, Dwyane Wade on Wednesday night reiterated his desire to finish his career in Miami and endorsed management’s offseason reworking of the roster.

“I thought Pat Riley and Micky Arison and Nick Arison did a great job of building this team,”

Dwyane Wade on Pat Riley, Micky Arison, Sep 17, 2015. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison
item.description:
After the Wade story was posted, a GM reached out to tell me:

“There’s absolutely no doubt that the top NBA stars are the most underpaid in sports. The max salaries created the Heat. The owners have only themselves to blame if they don’t like what happened with the Heat. There’s no way [Heat owner] Micky Arison could afford the $140 million to pay those three in a free market situation – and that’s $140 million annually.”

Dwyane Wade on Micky Arison, Oct 4, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
